{% stylesheet %} .craft-timeline{padding-bottom:48px} .craft-intro{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:80px 24px 96px;text-align:center} .craft-intro .eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:32px}.craft-intro .eyebrow:before,.craft-intro .eyebrow:after{content:"";width:16px;height:1px;background:var(--color-line)} .craft-intro h2{font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,38px);line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:32px} .craft-intro .rte{max-width:672px;margin:auto;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5} .craft-intro .rte p{margin:0} .craft-strip{padding:0 12px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-padding-inline:12px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--color-line) transparent} .craft-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--craft-columns),minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none} .craft-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;scroll-snap-align:start;position:relative} .craft-media{aspect-ratio:341/272;margin-bottom:24px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--studio-bg)} .template-product .craft-media{aspect-ratio:1} .craft-media img,.craft-media svg{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.craft-media img{filter:saturate(.8);transition:filter .7s}.craft-card:hover .craft-media img{filter:saturate(1)} .craft-day{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 12px} .craft-card h3{font-size:25px;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 12px} .craft-copy{max-width:38ch;font-size:13px;line-height:1.35} .craft-copy p{margin:0} @media(max-width:1023px){.craft-strip{overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px;overscroll-behavior-inline:contain}.craft-grid{grid-template-columns:none;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:290px;width:max-content}} @media(max-width:767px){.craft-intro{padding:48px 12px 56px}.craft-intro .eyebrow{font-size:9px;margin-bottom:24px}.craft-intro h2{margin-bottom:24px}.craft-intro .rte{font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}.craft-day{font-size:9px}.craft-card h3{font-size:17.11px}.craft-copy{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35}} {% endstylesheet %} {% javascript %} document.addEventListener('keydown', event => { const strip = event.target.closest('.craft-strip'); if (!strip || strip.scrollWidth <= strip.clientWidth) return; if (!['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return; event.preventDefault(); const grid = strip.querySelector('.craft-grid'); const step = strip.querySelector('.craft-card').getBoundingClientRect().width + parseFloat(getComputedStyle(grid).gap); const maximum = strip.scrollWidth - strip.clientWidth; let left = strip.scrollLeft; if (event.key === 'Home') left = 0; if (event.key === 'End') left = maximum; if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') left -= step; if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') left += step; strip.scrollTo({ left: Math.max(0, Math.min(maximum, left)), behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }); }); {% endjavascript %} {% schema %} { "name": "Leather timeline", "max_blocks": 4, "settings": [ {"type":"text","id":"eyebrow","label":"Eyebrow","default":"Craftsmanship"}, {"type":"text","id":"heading","label":"Heading","default":"VALUE IN THE MAKING"}, {"type":"richtext","id":"text","label":"Introduction","default":"

The character of the Vivienne begins in the leather.

From the first cut to the final detail, explore the elements that give the bag its shape, texture and quiet presence.

"} ], "blocks":[{ "type":"stage","name":"Stage","settings":[ {"type":"image_picker","id":"image","label":"Image"}, {"type":"text","id":"default_asset","label":"Included image filename"}, {"type":"text","id":"alt","label":"Image description"}, {"type":"text","id":"day","label":"Day or stage label"}, {"type":"text","id":"heading","label":"Heading","default":"Leather Selection & Cutting"}, {"type":"richtext","id":"text","label":"Description"} ] }], "presets":[{"name":"Leather timeline","blocks":[{"type":"stage","settings":{"day":"Day 1","heading":"Leather Selection & Cutting"}},{"type":"stage","settings":{"day":"Day 4–8","heading":"Thread Selection & Stitching"}},{"type":"stage","settings":{"day":"Finishing","heading":"Edge Paint & Finishing"}},{"type":"stage","settings":{"day":"Final review","heading":"Final Quality Inspection"}}]}] } {% endschema %}
